shared_elements: small animal figures shown in profile silhouette
quadruped with elongated body and short legs
bird-like creature with beak/head in profile
a long horizontal element crossing the field (painted shaft / carved band)
rows of repeated small motifs forming a band
justification: Both surfaces reduce animals to flat, outline-like profile shapes scattered across a rock face, and both include small discs and a strong horizontal element crossing the composition, but that is about as specific as the correspondence gets. A is dominated by one large red-painted human figure with a spear, with motifs loosely scattered around it, whereas B is a carved low-relief pillar organised into stacked horizontal registers with no comparable dominant figure; the media (paint versus sculpted stone) and the ordering principle are fundamentally different.
